edges.why: Step 1 instructs WebSurfer to search for Roy Rogers' third wife and Frank McDonald films.
Step 3 analyzes the search result from Step 2 identifying Dale Evans as the wife.
Step 3 instructs WebSurfer to search for films starring Roy Rogers and Dale Evans directed by Frank McDonald.
Step 5 analyzes the search result from Step 4 finding the film and year.
Step 6 analyzes the findings mentioned in Step 5 regarding multiple films.
Step 6 instructs WebSurfer to run targeted searches again (effectively reusing the query from Step 3/4) to confirm all films.
